Preparation only. No OTA was published and no emulator command was executed here.

Installed source inspected: expo-updates 57.0.25, Android database schema13.
db/UpdatesDatabase.kt: DB_NAME updates.db, MIGRATION_12_13 adds url/headers.
db/Converters.kt: UUID is ByteBuffer big-endian16bytes; READY=1, PENDING=3, EMBEDDED=5.
db/entity/UpdateEntity.kt: successful_launch_count, failed_launch_count and launch_asset_id.
errorrecovery/ErrorRecoveryHandler.kt: CONTENT_APPEARED calls markSuccessfulLaunchForLaunchedUpdate.
procedures/StartupProcedure.kt increments the launched update's successful counter.
This is observed native successful content appearance, alongside direct account and portfolio checks.

Only these rooted-emulator paths may be read:
/data/user/0/com.rwadar.app/databases/updates.db
/data/user/0/com.rwadar.app/databases/updates.db-wal
The package is force-stopped before copying so both files are stable. Local copies are temporary,
parsed through sqlite3 mode=ro/query_only, and deleted. Raw DB/WAL files never enter evidence export.
Root is allowed only after ro.kernel.qemu=1, ro.build.type=userdebug; then adbd uid0 is required.
No package scanning, SecureStore, preference files, backup extraction or other apps are read.

Workflow first refuses pending candidate or pending OTA metadata, before accounts/downloads.
APK source is c1f7106a49e988ca1dde214f0e75b7fe7d4d2719. OTA source is the REAL commit EAS
returns, which may differ due to web/docs/harness changes. Both commits must be locally available;
git diff --quiet APK_SHA OTA_SHA -- rwadar-movil must pass, current committed mobile source must
match APK, and git status --porcelain -- rwadar-movil must be empty. No gitCommitHash is rewritten.
JSON and observations retain apkSourceHeadSha, otaSourceHeadSha and original easGitCommitHash.
Expected OTA ID must be absent after the first APK23 offline launch. Once online, ON_LOAD may
download automatically. During the existing single QA portfolio pass, READY/status1 is observed,
then the same ID must increase successful_launch_count after a normal cold start. The same QA
account and existing portfolio fixture must remain visible. No Updates.reloadAsync/fetchUpdateAsync.
Missing DB/root, incompatible ID/runtime, failed launch or absent counter increase fails closed.

Installed EAS CLI help was run locally for update --help and update:view --help.
CLI path: C:/Users/vcicr/AppData/Local/npm-cache/_npx/03e34f479f818b15/node_modules/eas-cli/bin/run
Use bundled Node executable; cwd must be rwadar-movil. Commands for ROOT ONLY after APK ready,
identical reviewed mobile source from APK commit c1f7106a49e988ca1dde214f0e75b7fe7d4d2719
and authorized publication. Run the local compatibility guard immediately before EAS publication:

python3 .github/qa-android-update-141/ota.py guard-publish

node <CLI> update --channel production --platform android --environment production --message "RWAdar1.4.1 same-source OTA verification" --json --non-interactive
node <CLI> update:view <actual-group-or-platform-id-from-output> --json

Save the first command's actual stdout JSON as a UTF8 file. Do not invent the Android ID.
EAS installed build/update/utils.js getUpdateJsonInfosForUpdates returns an array with
id, group, platform, runtimeVersion, gitCommitHash, createdAt and isRollBackToEmbedded.
Update and update:view --json use that same array shape (without --insights).
The id field of the sole platform=android entry is the expected DB UUID; group is a different ID.

python3 .github/qa-android-update-141/ota.py record-eas-json <saved-production-publication-json>

This local command preserves the original EAS gitCommitHash as otaSourceHeadSha/easGitCommitHash.
It refuses mobile differences, dirty working mobile tree, unavailable source commits, wrong runtime,
rollback or multiple Android updates and fills ota.json schema2. It never substitutes the APK SHA.
Channel production is bound to the publication command, since that CLI JSON does not contain channel.
Commit the ready candidate/OTA metadata with the private QA harness before dispatch. Mobile source
must remain frozen. No configuration-only result certifies download or successful OTA launch.
